item.awaken.delvers_log.0.page0: The Carillon wants more bell metal than any hill has given it. The copper here runs down, so we follow it down. Twelve picks, two carts, a winch that squeals like the Watch's gulls.
item.awaken.delvers_log.0.page1: Third gallery opened. Good copper, a little tin. The men say the rock is warmer than it ought to be this deep. I told them that is the price of good copper. I wrote the seams on the map in lapis, so the next crew finds them.
item.awaken.delvers_log.0.title: Foreman Hessel's Log
item.awaken.delvers_log.1.page0: Past the chasm the lamps burn blue and the rock hums when you lay a hand on it. Hessel says it is the water. It is not the water.
item.awaken.delvers_log.1.page1: Ott found black glass in the wall today, glass that holds a light of its own. He would not put it in the cart. We left it where it grew. Nobody sleeps near the far drift now.
item.awaken.delvers_log.1.title: A Delver's Notes
item.awaken.delvers_log.2.page0: We broke into it. Violet, all of it, and warm, and something in there is breathing. Ott went in with a lamp. The lamp came back out on its own.
item.awaken.delvers_log.2.page1: We are sealing the drift. Tell the Carillon to find its metal somewhere else. The old ones said the Well goes down to where this comes from. I believe them now.
item.awaken.delvers_log.2.title: The Last Entry
item.awaken.delvers_log.desc: Use to read it. Read, it joins your Codex.
item.awaken.delvers_pick.desc: Worn smooth where the hands went. It knows where the metal is.
item.awaken.delvers_pick.perk: Carried: the Tuning Fork reaches %s further
item.awaken.lode_map.desc: Read it with a lapis (used up): the nearest lodes come up on your Gate Map.
item.awaken.lode_map.needs: The map's lines are drawn in lapis: carry one to read it
item.awaken.lode_map.none: No lode within the map's reach of here
subtitles.awaken.delve.cave.name: A place is named
